Campus Dining: Healthy Meal Options
Aldercrest University Dining invites students to explore our
Healthy Harvest Station.
Open Monday–Friday, 11:00 A.M.–2:00 P.M., at Maple Dining Hall.
Enjoy grilled vegetables, various grain bowls, turkey wraps, fruit
cups, and low-fat yogurt. Pick up a free nutrition guide at the
Commons Desk.
